definition_used: The change of an item’s status reflecting that a retracted item will be replaced with a new publication in the same journal. The journal has indicated that the replacement should be cited as the version of record.
caution: This is a status/notice term describing a publication-status change (retraction with replacement), not a root cause. It signals post-publication correction/update process but does not directly indicate a problem with research content, authorship, or editorial governance. Main figure prevalence is not recommended because the label is primarily about metadata transparency and version-of-record replacement.
semantic_rationale: The definition describes a change in publication status where a retracted item is replaced by a new version of record. This directly relates to post-publication transparency and due process oversight (manuscript category) because it involves a formal correction/update process (process_signal) managed by the journal/publisher (actor_context). The problem object is the article as a whole, as the replacement affects the entire publication.
